raw_text: Draw from knowledge of author, audience, and context to discern and establish a clear point of view or unique perspective when interpreting and constructing texts. (I/C)
competency_statement: Use what you know about the author, audience, and context to identify and express a clear point of view or unique perspective when reading or creating texts.
observable_behaviors: Explain who the author is writing for and why.
Identify the context of a text and how it influences the message.
State a clear point of view or perspective about a text.
Create a text that shows a unique perspective based on understanding the author, audience, and context.
skill_clauses: Draw from knowledge of the author to understand texts.
Draw from knowledge of the audience to understand texts.
Draw from knowledge of the context to understand texts.
Use this knowledge to discern a clear point of view or unique perspective when interpreting texts.
Use this knowledge to establish a clear point of view or unique perspective when constructing texts.

student_actions.recognition_identification: Recognize the author, audience, and context in texts.
student_actions.oral_production: Express a clear point of view or perspective orally when discussing texts.
student_actions.written_production: Write texts that show a clear point of view or unique perspective based on author, audience, and context.
student_actions.procedural_application: Apply knowledge of author, audience, and context to interpret and create texts with a clear perspective.
student_actions.reasoning_explanation: Explain how author, audience, and context influence the point of view or perspective in a text.
student_actions.comprehension_response: Interpret texts by identifying the author's purpose and perspective based on context and audience.
